title: University Funding and Programmable Compliance
question: Is university funding moving from annual institutional reporting toward recipient, award and payment controls, and has any ledger technology been selected?
bluf: Federal university funding is moving toward recipient-, award- and payment-level evidence and prepayment controls around a fragmented multi-entity system. Treasury prototyped a permissioned research-grant ledger, but the located prototype affected no real transaction and current rules remained technology-neutral; no public-blockchain mandate was established.
